rows.title: Finite information decomposition through an auxiliary variable
rows.contract: I(Y;Z)=H(Y|X)-I(X;Z|Y)-H(Y|(X,Z))+I(X;Z), in nats; arbitrary source type, exactly three observed Fintype alphabets, ordered pair (X,Z).

anchor_evidence.name: general_decomposition
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem general_decomposition
    {omega : Type u} {alpha : Type v} {beta : Type w} {gamma : Type x}
    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype gamma]
    (p : PMF omega) (X : omega → alpha) (Y : omega → beta) (Z : omega → gamma) :
    mutualInfoOf p Y Z =
      condEntropyOf p Y X - condMutualInfoOf p X Z Y -
        condEntropyOf p Y (fun omega => (X omega, Z omega)) +
        mutualInfoOf p X Z

anchor_evidence.name: zero_terms
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem zero_terms
    {omega : Type u} {alpha : Type v} {beta : Type w} {gamma : Type x}
    [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta] [Fintype gamma]
    (p : PMF omega) (X : omega → alpha) (Y : omega → beta) (Z : omega → gamma)
    (hMI : mutualInfoOf p X Z = 0)
    (hCond : condEntropyOf p Y (fun omega => (X omega, Z omega)) = 0) :
    mutualInfoOf p Y Z = condEntropyOf p Y X - condMutualInfoOf p X Z Y

anchor_evidence.name: singleton_auxiliary
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem singleton_auxiliary
    {omega : Type u} {beta : Type v} {gamma : Type w}
    [Fintype beta] [Fintype gamma]
    (p : PMF omega) (Y : omega → beta) (Z : omega → gamma) :
    mutualInfoOf p Y Z =
      condEntropyOf p Y (fun _ => ()) - condMutualInfoOf p (fun _ => ()) Z Y -
        condEntropyOf p Y (fun omega => ((), Z omega)) +
        mutualInfoOf p (fun _ => ()) Z

    sparseJoint (false, false, true) = (1 : ENNReal) / 2 ∧
    sparseJoint (true, true, false) = (1 : ENNReal) / 2 ∧
    sparseJoint (false, true, true) = 0

anchor_evidence.name: sparse_decomposition
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem sparse_decomposition :
    mutualInfoOf sparseJoint (fun s => s.2.1) (fun s => s.2.2) =
      condEntropyOf sparseJoint (fun s => s.2.1) (fun s => s.1) -
        condMutualInfoOf sparseJoint (fun s => s.1) (fun s => s.2.2) (fun s => s.2.1) -
        condEntropyOf sparseJoint (fun s => s.2.1) (fun s => (s.1, s.2.2)) +
        mutualInfoOf sparseJoint (fun s => s.1) (fun s => s.2.2)

original_growth_mechanism.original_requirement_excerpt:
**C9-GROW-06:** Before the first new production public declaration, exercise the
actual generator/checker paths in isolated, disposable source copies below the
authorized checkout's ignored `tmp/`. Never introduce deliberate breakage into the
real library. Retain commands, fixture source identity, compiler results, checker
results and expected-failure reasons separately from production evidence.

| Fixture | Required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Unchanged release and current library | Full retained coverage passes; independent baseline exports agree. |
| Documented compatible addition in an existing supported module | Compiles and passes current inventory, compatibility and trust; frozen bytes unchanged. |
| Documented new opt-in module plus approved umbrella addition and consumer | Passes the real growth path; exact current inventory/import/trust/docs coverage includes it. |
| The same otherwise-valid opt-in addition without its required policy approval | Fails specifically at the policy boundary, even after regenerating the current inventory; counts, documentation and ordinary imports otherwise pass. |
| Same retained name/owner/kind with an extra assumption | Mutated source still compiles, but retained type comparison fails at the altered binder. |
| Changed retained declaration with its old compiled artifact left in place; invoke only standalone `compatibility` | Rebuilds and detects the incompatibility, or explicitly refuses unestablished freshness; it must never pass using the old artifact. |
| Changed result type or explicit/implicit/named-argument contract | Fails retained comparison; test binder-name protection. |
| Removed, renamed or relocated retained declaration | Fails with the declaration and contract mismatch. |
| Added/removed retained simp attribute, or unapproved new simp membership | Fails independently of signature/count checks. |
| Retargeted root alias, heavy root import, changed retained focused import or non-stable leakage | Fails at the appropriate historical/policy/current-environment boundary. |
| Undocumented or unindexed supported addition, missing/duplicate docs block, stale attestation | Fails without accepting a larger count as sufficient evidence. |
| Same-name signature, body or docstring edit with unchanged current-manifest entries | Rejects the previous documentation attestation by its source-content fingerprint; valid freshly built output can establish new evidence. |
| Modified historical manifest or current artifact labeled as frozen route | Fails preservation/staging checks before publication or copying into that route. |
| Same-type changed definition body | Records the expected signature-check limitation and required source-review obligation; no claim that fingerprints establish semantics. |

Fixtures should target these failure modes, not mirror internal helper functions.
Small synthetic tests can cover classification; the compatible declaration,
approved/unapproved opt-in module pair, broken retained assumption and stale-compiled-
artifact scenario must run real Lean/source-copy integration checks. Keep expected
policy refusals distinct from compiler failures. HTML/fingerprint fixtures do not
substitute for the real two-pass doc-gen milestone in final closeout.

rows.contract: TV=(1/2)*sum abs((p a).toReal-(q a).toReal), Real-valued, [Fintype α], supplied PMFs; values in[0,1], separation/symmetry/triangle.

theorem totalVariation_nonneg (p q : PMF α) : 0 ≤ totalVariation p q
theorem totalVariation_le_one (p q : PMF α) : totalVariation p q ≤ 1
theorem totalVariation_self (p : PMF α) : totalVariation p p = 0
theorem totalVariation_comm (p q : PMF α) : totalVariation p q = totalVariation q p
theorem totalVariation_eq_zero_iff (p q : PMF α) : totalVariation p q = 0 ↔ p = q

theorem totalVariation_triangle (p q r : PMF α) :
    totalVariation p r ≤ totalVariation p q + totalVariation q r

rows.title: Finite Set-event interface and attained event envelopes
rows.contract: Existing PMF.toOuterMeasure Set probability agrees with finite Real sum. Non-strict event {a | q(a)≤p(a)} attains signed TV; all absolute events bounded; both greatest-value envelopes.

anchor_evidence.name: empty_full_events
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem empty_full_events {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p q : PMF α) :
    (p.toOuterMeasure ∅).toReal = 0 ∧ (p.toOuterMeasure Set.univ).toReal = 1 ∧
      |(p.toOuterMeasure ∅).toReal - (q.toOuterMeasure ∅).toReal| ≤ PMF.totalVariation p q ∧
      |(p.toOuterMeasure Set.univ).toReal - (q.toOuterMeasure Set.univ).toReal| ≤
        PMF.totalVariation p q

anchor_evidence.name: finset_event
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem finset_event {α : Type*} [Finite α] (p : PMF α) (s : Finset α) :
    (p.toOuterMeasure (s : Set α)).toReal = ∑ a ∈ s, (p a).toReal

anchor_evidence.name: all_tied_event
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem all_tied_event {α : Type*} [Finite α] (p : PMF α) :
    {a | (p a).toReal ≤ (p a).toReal} = (Set.univ : Set α) ∧
      (p.toOuterMeasure {a | (p a).toReal ≤ (p a).toReal}).toReal -
        (p.toOuterMeasure {a | (p a).toReal ≤ (p a).toReal}).toReal = 0

anchor_evidence.name: boolean_attaining_event
indicator_event_probability
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem indicator_event_probability {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (p : PMF α) (s : Set α) :
    ((p.map (eventIndicator s)).toOuterMeasure {true}).toReal =
      ∑ a, s.indicator (fun a => (p a).toReal) a

anchor_evidence.name: indicator_event_bound
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem indicator_event_bound {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (p q : PMF α) (s : Set α) :
    |((p.map (eventIndicator s)).toOuterMeasure {true}).toReal -
      ((q.map (eventIndicator s)).toOuterMeasure {true}).toReal| ≤ PMF.totalVariation p q

anchor_evidence.name: boolean_indicator_gap
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem boolean_indicator_gap :
    (((booleanLaw false).map (eventIndicator {false})).toOuterMeasure {true}).toReal -
      (((booleanLaw true).map (eventIndicator {false})).toOuterMeasure {true}).toReal =
        PMF.totalVariation (booleanLaw false) (booleanLaw true)

anchor_evidence.name: signed_event_envelope_iff
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem signed_event_envelope_iff {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (p q : PMF α) (c : ℝ) :
    (∀ s : Set α, (p.toOuterMeasure s).toReal - (q.toOuterMeasure s).toReal ≤ c) ↔
      PMF.totalVariation p q ≤ c

anchor_evidence.name: absolute_event_envelope_iff
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem absolute_event_envelope_iff {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (p q : PMF α) (c : ℝ) :
    (∀ s : Set α, |(p.toOuterMeasure s).toReal - (q.toOuterMeasure s).toReal| ≤ c) ↔
      PMF.totalVariation p q ≤ c

declaration_evidence.source_signature:
theorem toOuterMeasure_toReal_eq_sum (p : PMF α) (s : Set α) :
    (p.toOuterMeasure s).toReal = ∑ a, s.indicator (fun a => (p a).toReal) a

theorem totalVariation_eq_sum_pos (p q : PMF α) :
    totalVariation p q =
      ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => (q a).toReal ≤ (p a).toReal),
        ((p a).toReal - (q a).toReal)

theorem abs_toOuterMeasure_sub_le_totalVariation (p q : PMF α) (s : Set α) :
    |(p.toOuterMeasure s).toReal - (q.toOuterMeasure s).toReal| ≤ totalVariation p q

theorem totalVariation_eq_toOuterMeasure_sub (p q : PMF α) :
    totalVariation p q =
      (p.toOuterMeasure {a | (q a).toReal ≤ (p a).toReal}).toReal -
        (q.toOuterMeasure {a | (q a).toReal ≤ (p a).toReal}).toReal

theorem totalVariation_isGreatest_event (p q : PMF α) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range (fun s : Set α =>
      (p.toOuterMeasure s).toReal - (q.toOuterMeasure s).toReal)) (totalVariation p q)

theorem totalVariation_isGreatest_abs_event (p q : PMF α) :
    IsGreatest (Set.range (fun s : Set α =>
      |(p.toOuterMeasure s).toReal - (q.toOuterMeasure s).toReal|)) (totalVariation p q)

rows.title: Overlap/residual totals and disjoint-support endpoint
rows.contract: Real overlap/min identities and ENNReal common/residual masses, with TV=1 iff actual supports are disjoint; no positivity/support restriction.

anchor_evidence.name: overlap_residual_totals
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem overlap_residual_totals {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p q : PMF α) :
    (∑ a, min (p a) (q a)) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - PMF.totalVariation p q) ∧
    (∑ a, (p a - min (p a) (q a))) = ENNReal.ofReal (PMF.totalVariation p q) ∧
    (∑ a, (q a - min (p a) (q a))) = ENNReal.ofReal (PMF.totalVariation p q)

anchor_evidence.name: overlap_residual_finite
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem overlap_residual_finite {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p q : PMF α) :
    (∑ a, min (p a) (q a)) < ⊤ ∧
    (∑ a, (p a - min (p a) (q a))) < ⊤ ∧
    (∑ a, (q a - min (p a) (q a))) < ⊤

anchor_evidence.name: interior_positive_totals
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem interior_positive_totals {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (p q : PMF α)
    (h0 : 0 < PMF.totalVariation p q) (h1 : PMF.totalVariation p q < 1) :
    0 < (∑ a, min (p a) (q a)) ∧
    0 < (∑ a, (p a - min (p a) (q a))) ∧
    0 < (∑ a, (q a - min (p a) (q a)))

anchor_evidence.name: interior_normalization_premises
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem interior_normalization_premises {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (p q : PMF α) (h0 : 0 < PMF.totalVariation p q)
    (h1 : PMF.totalVariation p q < 1) :
    ((∑' a, min (p a) (q a)) ≠ 0 ∧ (∑' a, min (p a) (q a)) ≠ ⊤) ∧

anchor_evidence.name: block_split
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem block_split {A : Type v} {B : Type w} [Fintype B]
    (m n : ℕ) (W : Fin (m + n) → A → PMF B) (x : Fin (m + n) → A) :
    (PMF.productChannel W x).map (Fin.appendEquiv m n).symm =
      PMF.channelJoint
        (PMF.productChannel (fun i => W (Fin.castAdd n i)) (fun i => x (Fin.castAdd n i)))
        (fun _ => PMF.productChannel (fun i => W (Fin.natAdd m i))
          (fun i => x (Fin.natAdd m i)))

anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem block_rebuild {A : Type v} {B : Type w} [Fintype B]
    (m n : ℕ) (W : Fin (m + n) → A → PMF B) (x : Fin (m + n) → A) :
    (PMF.channelJoint
        (PMF.productChannel (fun i => W (Fin.castAdd n i)) (fun i => x (Fin.castAdd n i)))
        (fun _ => PMF.productChannel (fun i => W (Fin.natAdd m i))
          (fun i => x (Fin.natAdd m i)))).map (Fin.appendEquiv m n) =
      PMF.productChannel W x

theorem finiteProduct_map_append_symm
    {A : Type v} [Fintype A] (m n : ℕ) (p : Fin (m + n) → PMF A) :
    (finiteProduct p).map (Fin.appendEquiv m n).symm =
      channelJoint
        (finiteProduct (fun i => p (Fin.castAdd n i)))
        (fun _ => finiteProduct (fun j => p (Fin.natAdd m j)))

    {A : Type v} [Fintype A] {m n : ℕ}

    (channelJoint (finiteProduct p) (fun _ => finiteProduct q)).map
        (Fin.appendEquiv m n) = finiteProduct (Fin.append p q)

anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem joint_atom
    {I : Type u} {A : I → Type v} {B : I → Type w}
    [Fintype I] [∀ i, Fintype (B i)]
    (q : PMF (∀ i, A i)) (W : ∀ i, A i → PMF (B i))
    (x : ∀ i, A i) (y : ∀ i, B i) :
    PMF.channelJoint q (PMF.productChannel W) (x, y) =
      q x * ∏ i, W i (x i) (y i)

    {I : Type u} {A : I → Type v} {B : I → Type w}
    [Fintype I] [∀ i, Fintype (B i)]
    (q : PMF (∀ i, A i)) (W : ∀ i, A i → PMF (B i))
    (x : ∀ i, A i) (y : ∀ i, B i) :
    (x, y) ∈ (PMF.channelJoint q (PMF.productChannel W)).support ↔
      x ∈ q.support ∧ ∀ i, y i ∈ (W i (x i)).support

private theorem arbitrary_law_bounds {X : Type u} [Fintype X]
    (q : PMF X) (T : Finset X) {M : ℕ} (hT : T.card ≤ M) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hcap : ∀ x ∈ T, (q x).toReal ≤ b) :

      (q.toOuterMeasure (T : Set X)ᶜ).toReal + (M : ℝ) * b)

anchor_evidence.name: above_entropy_same_family
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem above_entropy_same_family {A : Type u} [Fintype A]
    (p : PMF A) {R : ℝ} (hR : entropy p < R) :
    ∃ M : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ n, 1 ≤ M n) ∧
      ∃ c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode A n (M n),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid p n))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        (∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ R) ∧
        (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η →
          ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ R + η)

private theorem pure_bool_above_entropy {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ M : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ n, 1 ≤ M n) ∧
      ∃ c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode Bool n (M n),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid (PMF.pure false) n))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        (∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ R)

anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem biasedSparse_above_entropy :

private theorem source_coding_package {A : Type u} [Fintype A] (p : PMF A) :
    IsGLB {R : ℝ | ∃ M : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ n, 1 ≤ M n) ∧
      ∃ c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode A n (M n),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid p n))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ R + η)}
      (entropy p) ∧
    (∀ (R : ℝ) (M : ℕ → ℕ) (_hM : ∀ n, 1 ≤ M n)
      (c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode A n (M n)),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid p n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ R + η) →
      entropy p ≤ R) ∧
    (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ M : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ n, 1 ≤ M n) ∧
      ∃ c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode A n (M n),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid p n))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        (∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ entropy p + δ) ∧
        (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η →
          ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ entropy p + δ + η)) ∧
    (∀ (M : ℕ → ℕ) (_hM : ∀ n, 1 ≤ M n)
      (c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode A n (M n)) (R : ℝ),
      R < entropy p → (∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ R) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid p n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 1)) ∧
    (∀ (M : ℕ → ℕ) (_hM : ∀ n, 1 ≤ M n)
      (c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode A n (M n)),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid p n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, entropy p - δ ≤ codeRate n (M n))

private theorem typical_success_bound {A : Type u} [Fintype A]
    (p : PMF A) (n M : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (c : BlockSourceCode A n M) :

anchor_evidence.name: source_coding_package
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem source_coding_package {A : Type u} [Fintype A] (p : PMF A) :
    IsGLB {R : ℝ | ∃ M : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ n, 1 ≤ M n) ∧
      ∃ c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode A n (M n),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid p n))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ R + η)}
      (entropy p) ∧
    (∀ (R : ℝ) (M : ℕ → ℕ) (_hM : ∀ n, 1 ≤ M n)
      (c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode A n (M n)),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid p n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ R + η) →
      entropy p ≤ R) ∧
    (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ M : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ n, 1 ≤ M n) ∧
      ∃ c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode A n (M n),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid p n))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        (∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ entropy p + δ) ∧
        (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η →
          ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ entropy p + δ + η)) ∧
    (∀ (M : ℕ → ℕ) (_hM : ∀ n, 1 ≤ M n)
      (c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode A n (M n)) (R : ℝ),
      R < entropy p → (∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ R) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid p n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 1)) ∧
    (∀ (M : ℕ → ℕ) (_hM : ∀ n, 1 ≤ M n)
      (c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode A n (M n)),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid p n))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, entropy p - δ ≤ codeRate n (M n))

private theorem biasedSparse_operational_compression :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < entropy biasedSparse ∧ entropy biasedSparse < R ∧ R < Real.log 2 ∧
      ∃ M : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ _hM : ∀ n, 1 ≤ M n,
        ∃ c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode (Fin 3) n (M n),
          Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid biasedSparse n))
            Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
          (∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ R) ∧
          (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ R + η) ∧
          entropy biasedSparse ≤ R ∧
          (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
            ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, entropy biasedSparse - δ ≤ codeRate n (M n)) ∧
          (∀ (M' : ℕ → ℕ) (_hM' : ∀ n, 1 ≤ M' n)
            (c' : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode (Fin 3) n (M' n)) (R' : ℝ),
            R' < entropy biasedSparse →
            (∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, codeRate n (M' n) ≤ R') →
            Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (c' n).errorProbability (PMF.iid biasedSparse n))
              Filter.atTop (nhds 1))

anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem same_maximizing_input {A : Type u} {B : Type v}
    [Fintype A] [Nonempty A] [Fintype B] (W : A → PMF B) :
    ∃ p : PMF A, mutualInfo (PMF.channelJoint p W) = channelCapacity W ∧
      (∀ q : PMF A, mutualInfo (PMF.channelJoint q W) ≤
        mutualInfo (PMF.channelJoint p W)) ∧
      (∀ r : ℝ, mutualInfo (PMF.channelJoint p W) ≤ r ↔
        ∀ q : PMF A, mutualInfo (PMF.channelJoint q W) ≤ r)

anchor_evidence.visibility: private source spelling, not an exported constant name
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem actual_marginals {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [Fintype B]
    {n M : ℕ} (c : BlockChannelCode A B n M) (W : A → PMF B) (hM : 1 ≤ M) :
    letI : Nonempty (Fin M) := ⟨⟨0, hM⟩⟩
    let U := PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin M)
    let Q := c.messageInputOutputLaw W hM
    Q.map Prod.fst = U ∧
      Q.map (fun z => z.2.1) = U.map c.encoder ∧
      Q.map (fun z => z.2.2) = (U.map c.encoder).bind (PMF.memorylessChannel W n) ∧
      Q.map (fun z => (z.1, z.2.1)) = U.map (fun m => (m, c.encoder m)) ∧
      Q.map Prod.snd = PMF.channelJoint (U.map c.encoder) (PMF.memorylessChannel W n) ∧
      Q.map (fun z => (z.1, z.2.2)) = c.messageOutputLaw W hM ∧
      (c.messageOutputLaw W hM).map Prod.fst = U

private theorem alternating_complete_interface :
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      (alternatingTriple n).map (fun z => (z.1, z.2.2)) =
          (alternatingCode n).messageOutputLaw noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) ∧
      (alternatingTriple n).map Prod.snd =
          PMF.channelJoint (alternatingInput n) (PMF.memorylessChannel noiseless n) ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          decodingErrorProbabilityOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
            (alternatingCode n).decoder ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          ((alternatingTriple n).toOuterMeasure
            {z | (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2 ≠ z.1}).toReal ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) = 0 ∧
      IsMarkovChain (alternatingTriple n) ∧
      IsMarkovChainOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) - Real.log 2 -
          (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) *
            Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless ∧
      (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
          Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 ∧
      (0 < n →
        (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
            codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤
            channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 / (n : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → R ≤ codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) →
          1 - channelCapacity noiseless / R - Real.log 2 / ((n : ℝ) * R) ≤
            (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))) ∧
    (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤ channelCapacity noiseless + δ) ∧
    Filter.limsup (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop ≤
      channelCapacity noiseless ∧
    Tendsto
      (fun n => (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))
      atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ l : ℝ, ¬ Tendsto (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop (nhds l))

theorem decodingErrorProbabilityOf_eq_toOuterMeasure
    {omega : Type u} {alpha : Type v} {beta : Type w}
    (p : PMF omega) (X : omega → alpha) (Y : omega → beta)
    (decoder : beta → alpha) :
    decodingErrorProbabilityOf p X Y decoder =
      (p.toOuterMeasure {ω | decoder (Y ω) ≠ X ω}).toReal

anchor_evidence.visibility: private source spelling, not an exported constant name
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem alternating_complete_interface :
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      (alternatingTriple n).map (fun z => (z.1, z.2.2)) =
          (alternatingCode n).messageOutputLaw noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) ∧
      (alternatingTriple n).map Prod.snd =
          PMF.channelJoint (alternatingInput n) (PMF.memorylessChannel noiseless n) ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          decodingErrorProbabilityOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
            (alternatingCode n).decoder ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          ((alternatingTriple n).toOuterMeasure
            {z | (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2 ≠ z.1}).toReal ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) = 0 ∧
      IsMarkovChain (alternatingTriple n) ∧
      IsMarkovChainOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) - Real.log 2 -
          (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) *
            Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless ∧
      (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
          Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 ∧
      (0 < n →
        (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
            codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤
            channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 / (n : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → R ≤ codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) →
          1 - channelCapacity noiseless / R - Real.log 2 / ((n : ℝ) * R) ≤
            (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))) ∧
    (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤ channelCapacity noiseless + δ) ∧
    Filter.limsup (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop ≤
      channelCapacity noiseless ∧
    Tendsto
      (fun n => (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))
      atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ l : ℝ, ¬ Tendsto (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop (nhds l))

private theorem alternating_complete_interface :
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      (alternatingTriple n).map (fun z => (z.1, z.2.2)) =
          (alternatingCode n).messageOutputLaw noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) ∧
      (alternatingTriple n).map Prod.snd =
          PMF.channelJoint (alternatingInput n) (PMF.memorylessChannel noiseless n) ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          decodingErrorProbabilityOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
            (alternatingCode n).decoder ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          ((alternatingTriple n).toOuterMeasure
            {z | (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2 ≠ z.1}).toReal ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) = 0 ∧
      IsMarkovChain (alternatingTriple n) ∧
      IsMarkovChainOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) - Real.log 2 -
          (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) *
            Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless ∧
      (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
          Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 ∧
      (0 < n →
        (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
            codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤
            channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 / (n : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → R ≤ codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) →
          1 - channelCapacity noiseless / R - Real.log 2 / ((n : ℝ) * R) ≤
            (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))) ∧
    (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤ channelCapacity noiseless + δ) ∧
    Filter.limsup (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop ≤
      channelCapacity noiseless ∧
    Tendsto
      (fun n => (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))
      atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ l : ℝ, ¬ Tendsto (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop (nhds l))

private theorem alternating_complete_interface :
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      (alternatingTriple n).map (fun z => (z.1, z.2.2)) =
          (alternatingCode n).messageOutputLaw noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) ∧
      (alternatingTriple n).map Prod.snd =
          PMF.channelJoint (alternatingInput n) (PMF.memorylessChannel noiseless n) ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          decodingErrorProbabilityOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
            (alternatingCode n).decoder ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          ((alternatingTriple n).toOuterMeasure
            {z | (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2 ≠ z.1}).toReal ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) = 0 ∧
      IsMarkovChain (alternatingTriple n) ∧
      IsMarkovChainOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) - Real.log 2 -
          (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) *
            Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless ∧
      (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
          Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 ∧
      (0 < n →
        (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
            codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤
            channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 / (n : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → R ≤ codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) →
          1 - channelCapacity noiseless / R - Real.log 2 / ((n : ℝ) * R) ≤
            (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))) ∧
    (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤ channelCapacity noiseless + δ) ∧
    Filter.limsup (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop ≤
      channelCapacity noiseless ∧
    Tendsto
      (fun n => (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))
      atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ l : ℝ, ¬ Tendsto (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop (nhds l))

private theorem alternating_complete_interface :
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      (alternatingTriple n).map (fun z => (z.1, z.2.2)) =
          (alternatingCode n).messageOutputLaw noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) ∧
      (alternatingTriple n).map Prod.snd =
          PMF.channelJoint (alternatingInput n) (PMF.memorylessChannel noiseless n) ∧

          decodingErrorProbabilityOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
            (alternatingCode n).decoder ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          ((alternatingTriple n).toOuterMeasure
            {z | (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2 ≠ z.1}).toReal ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) = 0 ∧
      IsMarkovChain (alternatingTriple n) ∧
      IsMarkovChainOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) - Real.log 2 -
          (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) *
            Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless ∧
      (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
          Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 ∧
      (0 < n →
        (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
            codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤
            channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 / (n : ℝ) ∧

    (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤ channelCapacity noiseless + δ) ∧
    Filter.limsup (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop ≤
      channelCapacity noiseless ∧
    Tendsto
      (fun n => (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))
      atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ l : ℝ, ¬ Tendsto (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop (nhds l))

For the eventual premise, use the noiseless Boolean channel with positive capacity `log 2`, budgets `M n = 4^n`, and constant encoding/decoding: prove actual error `1-1/(4^n)` and rate `2*log 2` for `n>0`; specialize the public pointwise bound with `R=2*log 2` to `Pe_n ≥ 1/2-1/(2*n)`, including the finite nonvacuous instance `n=2`, `M=16`, `Pe≥1/4`, and separately apply the public eventual obstruction. For the frequent premise, retain a zero-capacity constant-output channel with singleton budgets on even lengths and `2^(n*n)` on odd lengths. Prove unbounded rate spikes, infinitely many error-zero lengths and no eventual positive error floor.

parent_assessment.reason: The public finite coding bound is consumed with all four standard capacities and actual one-letter errors: noiseless identity0; input-independent uniform output1/2; BSC identity-decoder epsilon; BEC total fallback epsilon/2. Each consumer first computes the actual one-letter law/error from the public model, then starts with one_sub_errorProbability_mul_log_le and rewrites the relevant public capacity formula. The BEC decoder succeeds for one of the two messages even on erasure, hence epsilon/2 rather than epsilon.

theorem messageOutputLaw_one_map [Fintype B] (c : BlockChannelCode A B 1 M)

theorem errorProbability_one_length_eq_sum [Fintype B]
    (c : BlockChannelCode A B 1 M) (W : A → PMF B) (hM : 1 ≤ M) :
    c.errorProbability W hM = (1 / (M : ℝ)) * ∑ m, ∑ b : B,
      if c.decoder (fun _ => b) ≠ m then (W (c.encoder m 0) b).toReal else 0

parent_assessment.reason: The complete same-code/same-channel sampling, actual error, information, finite/normalized/pointwise rate and asymptotic interfaces compose on one actual alternating lossless family, while all collision/standard/adversarial fixtures remain permanent. alternating_complete_interface fixes the same code at each n, its actual uniform-message pushforward and triple law. It proves both pair projections and RV/event error identities, error zero, both Markov chains, decoder DPI, uniform-message Fano, message/input DPI, actual-q capacity, undivided finite inequality, guarded normalized/pointwise forms, every tolerance cap, limsup bound and failure of every ordinary real rate limit. assumptions_and_universes: A : Type u, B : Type v; [Fintype A] [Nonempty A] [Fintype B], W : A -> PMF B, actual c : BlockChannelCode A B n M and hM : 1<=M. Output nonemptiness is not an additional public premise. C=channelCapacity W, Pe=c.errorProbability W hM, r=codeRate n M, all information/rates in Real nats. Family data: M : Nat -> Nat, hM : forall n, 1<=M n, c : forall n, BlockChannelCode A B n (M n); one fixed W. e_n=(c n).errorProbability W (hM n), r_n=codeRate n (M n). Limits, eventually and frequently are along Filter.atTop on ALL natural lengths. Concrete noiseless Bool family alternatingCode/alternatingBudget and actual alternatingInput/alternatingTriple, with no rate limit.

anchor_evidence.name: alternating_complete_interface
anchor_evidence.visibility: private source spelling, not an exported constant name
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem alternating_complete_interface :
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      (alternatingTriple n).map (fun z => (z.1, z.2.2)) =
          (alternatingCode n).messageOutputLaw noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) ∧
      (alternatingTriple n).map Prod.snd =
          PMF.channelJoint (alternatingInput n) (PMF.memorylessChannel noiseless n) ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          decodingErrorProbabilityOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
            (alternatingCode n).decoder ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          ((alternatingTriple n).toOuterMeasure
            {z | (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2 ≠ z.1}).toReal ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) = 0 ∧
      IsMarkovChain (alternatingTriple n) ∧
      IsMarkovChainOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) - Real.log 2 -
          (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) *
            Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless ∧
      (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
          Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 ∧
      (0 < n →
        (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
            codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤
            channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 / (n : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → R ≤ codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) →
          1 - channelCapacity noiseless / R - Real.log 2 / ((n : ℝ) * R) ≤
            (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))) ∧
    (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤ channelCapacity noiseless + δ) ∧
    Filter.limsup (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop ≤
      channelCapacity noiseless ∧
    Tendsto
      (fun n => (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))
      atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ l : ℝ, ¬ Tendsto (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop (nhds l))

source_adaptations.adaptation: Indexed total deterministic encoder/decoder, original uniform Fin M messages and explicit positive natural budgets. Use nats, retain colliding message identity and average error. No reserved erasure index, maximal-error equivalence or optimal decoder claim. Raw law finiteness is outputs only.

sources: C18 arbitrary-input product-channel MI inequality; C22 ProductChannelCapacity
source_adaptations.adaptation: Product capacity upper bound ranges over every actual q, using its actual coordinate marginals. Product maximizers establish the capacity identity, not a necessary iid/injective premise on the code-induced q. C23 passes U.map encoder unchanged.

Use existing undivided uniform-source Fano, with log2 nats replacing the textbook bit constant1. No division by1-Pe, so error1 is valid; only normalized/pointwise forms require n>0/R>0. The registered PW24 alternative-proof indicator/probability wording mismatch is not imported; canonical decoding-error semantics and actual message marginal remain authoritative.

Arbitrary dependent positive-budget family rather than a fixed-rate sequence. Explicitly derive eventual boundedness, then control error times a fixed bound before tolerance/real-limsup results. Operational-capacity definitions, expurgation and channel-achievability statements are excluded context. Extra finite-prefix mutation is optional under approved criteria; theorem generality still allows arbitrary finite-prefix behavior.

sources: CT918.9/PW2417.4 finite weak-converse motivation; project derivations
source_adaptations.adaptation: C<R plus eventual R<=rate gives an eventual positive error floor. A fixed positive gap only frequently gives failure of error->0, not an eventual floor or error->1. The frequent theorem is a local derivation by contradiction from the tolerance cap, not attributed verbatim to a numbered textbook result.

sources: CT91 sections8.1.4-8.1.5; PW24 section19.3; C22 delivered capacity formulas
source_adaptations.adaptation: Use actual one-letter code errors and nats capacity formulas. BSC identity decoding has error epsilon including crossover1. BEC total erasure fallback has average error epsilon/2, not epsilon. Preserve erasure weight(1-epsilon) in capacity, endpoints and no unqualified optimizer-uniqueness claim.

anchor_evidence.visibility: private source spelling, not an exported constant name
anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem actual_marginals {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [Fintype B]
    {n M : ℕ} (c : BlockChannelCode A B n M) (W : A → PMF B) (hM : 1 ≤ M) :
    letI : Nonempty (Fin M) := ⟨⟨0, hM⟩⟩
    let U := PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin M)
    let Q := c.messageInputOutputLaw W hM
    Q.map Prod.fst = U ∧
      Q.map (fun z => z.2.1) = U.map c.encoder ∧
      Q.map (fun z => z.2.2) = (U.map c.encoder).bind (PMF.memorylessChannel W n) ∧
      Q.map (fun z => (z.1, z.2.1)) = U.map (fun m => (m, c.encoder m)) ∧
      Q.map Prod.snd = PMF.channelJoint (U.map c.encoder) (PMF.memorylessChannel W n) ∧
      Q.map (fun z => (z.1, z.2.2)) = c.messageOutputLaw W hM ∧
      (c.messageOutputLaw W hM).map Prod.fst = U

private theorem alternating_complete_interface :
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      (alternatingTriple n).map (fun z => (z.1, z.2.2)) =
          (alternatingCode n).messageOutputLaw noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) ∧
      (alternatingTriple n).map Prod.snd =
          PMF.channelJoint (alternatingInput n) (PMF.memorylessChannel noiseless n) ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          decodingErrorProbabilityOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
            (alternatingCode n).decoder ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          ((alternatingTriple n).toOuterMeasure
            {z | (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2 ≠ z.1}).toReal ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) = 0 ∧
      IsMarkovChain (alternatingTriple n) ∧
      IsMarkovChainOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) - Real.log 2 -
          (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) *
            Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless ∧
      (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
          Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 ∧
      (0 < n →
        (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
            codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤
            channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 / (n : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → R ≤ codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) →
          1 - channelCapacity noiseless / R - Real.log 2 / ((n : ℝ) * R) ≤
            (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))) ∧
    (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤ channelCapacity noiseless + δ) ∧
    Filter.limsup (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop ≤
      channelCapacity noiseless ∧
    Tendsto
      (fun n => (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))
      atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ l : ℝ, ¬ Tendsto (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop (nhds l))

producer_source_anchors.name: typical_rate_converse
producer_source_anchors.source_signature:
private theorem typical_rate_converse {A : Type u} [Fintype A]
    (p : PMF A) (ε R : ℝ) {n M : ℕ} (c : BlockSourceCode A n M)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hR : codeRate n M ≤ R) :
    1 - c.errorProbability (PMF.iid p n) ≤
      ((PMF.iid p n).toOuterMeasure
        (↑(weakTypicalSet p n ε) : Set (Fin n → A))ᶜ).toReal +
          Real.exp (-(n : ℝ) * (entropy p - ε - R))

producer_source_anchors.name: sourceCoding_threshold
producer_source_anchors.source_signature:
theorem sourceCoding_threshold {A : Type u} [Fintype A] (p : PMF A) :
    IsGLB {R : ℝ | ∃ M : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ n, 1 ≤ M n) ∧
      ∃ c : ∀ n, BlockSourceCode A n (M n),
        Tendsto (fun n => (c n).errorProbability (PMF.iid p n)) atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ n in atTop, codeRate n (M n) ≤ R + η)}
      (entropy p)

rows.title: Actual channel-code law/error/rate → Fano weak converse
rows.contract: The actual code law/error and shared nats rate compose with raw memoryless sampling, Markov/DPI, uniform-source Fano and the arbitrary-input repeated capacity bound on the SAME code/family. Derived boundedness precedes real limsup and eventual/frequent obstructions remain distinct.

parent_assessment.reason: The actual code law/error and shared nats rate compose with raw memoryless sampling, Markov/DPI, uniform-source Fano and the arbitrary-input repeated capacity bound on the SAME code/family. Derived boundedness precedes real limsup and eventual/frequent obstructions remain distinct. C17 memorylessChannel supplies conditional output rows at actual encoder words, without making q iid. Q carries original uniform messages and the encoder graph; its input/output marginal is channelJoint(U.map encoder,K). Actual-law Markov and decoder processing yield both DPIs. Fano uses uniform first marginal of J; C22 arbitrary-q repeated capacity bounds the very same encoder pushforward via C18 arbitrary-input information bounds and capacity. C20 codeRate converts the undivided nats inequality only for n>0. For one arbitrary family, finite Fano plus vanishing error derives2(C+log2) eventual rate bound before tolerance and guarded real limsup. Positive eventual lower-rate premise gives quantitative/floor obstructions; frequent fixed gap gives only nonvanishing, by contradiction with the tolerance cap.

anchor_evidence.source_signature:
private theorem alternating_complete_interface :
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      (alternatingTriple n).map (fun z => (z.1, z.2.2)) =
          (alternatingCode n).messageOutputLaw noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) ∧
      (alternatingTriple n).map Prod.snd =
          PMF.channelJoint (alternatingInput n) (PMF.memorylessChannel noiseless n) ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          decodingErrorProbabilityOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
            (alternatingCode n).decoder ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) =
          ((alternatingTriple n).toOuterMeasure
            {z | (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2 ≠ z.1}).toReal ∧
      (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) = 0 ∧
      IsMarkovChain (alternatingTriple n) ∧
      IsMarkovChainOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2)
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst
          (fun z => (alternatingCode n).decoder z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) - Real.log 2 -
          (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n) *
            Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) Prod.fst (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ∧
      mutualInfoOf (alternatingTriple n) (fun z => z.2.1) (fun z => z.2.2) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless ∧
      (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
          Real.log (alternatingBudget n : ℝ) ≤
          (n : ℝ) * channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 ∧
      (0 < n →
        (1 - (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n)) *
            codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤
            channelCapacity noiseless + Real.log 2 / (n : ℝ) ∧
        ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → R ≤ codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) →
          1 - channelCapacity noiseless / R - Real.log 2 / ((n : ℝ) * R) ≤
            (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))) ∧
    (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      codeRate n (alternatingBudget n) ≤ channelCapacity noiseless + δ) ∧
    Filter.limsup (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop ≤
      channelCapacity noiseless ∧
    Tendsto
      (fun n => (alternatingCode n).errorProbability noiseless (alternatingBudget_pos n))
      atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∀ l : ℝ, ¬ Tendsto (fun n => codeRate n (alternatingBudget n)) atTop (nhds l))

source_adaptations.adaptation: Indexed total deterministic encoder/decoder, original uniform Fin M messages and explicit positive natural budgets. Use nats, retain colliding message identity and average error. No reserved erasure index, maximal-error equivalence or optimal decoder claim. Raw law finiteness is outputs only.

sources: Local C17 raw product/memoryless channel and existing PMF channel algebra
source_adaptations.adaptation: Conditional output coordinates factor at a supplied word; this never asserts independence of the encoder pushforward. Right-associated message/input/output law and cross-product Markov proof include null fibers without choosing conditional-law meanings.

sources: C18 arbitrary-input product-channel MI inequality; C22 ProductChannelCapacity
source_adaptations.adaptation: Product capacity upper bound ranges over every actual q, using its actual coordinate marginals. Product maximizers establish the capacity identity, not a necessary iid/injective premise on the code-induced q. C23 passes U.map encoder unchanged.

Use existing undivided uniform-source Fano, with log2 nats replacing the textbook bit constant1. No division by1-Pe, so error1 is valid; only normalized/pointwise forms require n>0/R>0. The registered PW24 alternative-proof indicator/probability wording mismatch is not imported; canonical decoding-error semantics and actual message marginal remain authoritative.

sources: Existing C20 Shannon.CodingRate; CT91/PW24 code-rate conventions
source_adaptations.adaptation: codeRate n M=Real.log M/n with natural M. Its n=0 value is totalized zero, not normalization. No informal noninteger2^(nR) message counts or extra bit-valued duplicate APIs.

Arbitrary dependent positive-budget family rather than a fixed-rate sequence. Explicitly derive eventual boundedness, then control error times a fixed bound before tolerance/real-limsup results. Operational-capacity definitions, expurgation and channel-achievability statements are excluded context. Extra finite-prefix mutation is optional under approved criteria; theorem generality still allows arbitrary finite-prefix behavior.

Filter.limsup_le_iff' for real rates requires IsCoboundedUnder and IsBoundedUnder; both are explicit, with atTop Nat nontrivial. Use eventual upper bound and global rate nonnegativity. Frequent arbitrary unbounded obstruction does not use limsup.

sources: CT918.9/PW2417.4 finite weak-converse motivation; project derivations
source_adaptations.adaptation: C<R plus eventual R<=rate gives an eventual positive error floor. A fixed positive gap only frequently gives failure of error->0, not an eventual floor or error->1. The frequent theorem is a local derivation by contradiction from the tolerance cap, not attributed verbatim to a numbered textbook result.

adaptations: CT91 information capacity is separate from operational equality. Project attainment uses actual finite-PMF compactness and continuous MI with nonempty input domain; no coding achievability is inferred.
